aka: The color of those cherries reminds me of something beautiful
this_title: EL COLOR DE ESAS CEREZAS ME RECUERDA ALGO HERMOSO
trans_title: The color of those cherries reminds me of something beautiful
introduction: Román and Abigaíl are two teenagers who travel at night to a motel in the city with the intention of having their ﬁrst sexual encounter, however, chance will cause that encounter to take an unexpected turn, challenging the limits of reality and they will ﬁnd themselves before the most intense night they have experienced so far.
chinese_title: EL COLOR DE ESAS CEREZAS ME RECUERDA ALGO HERMOSO
